decisions.decision: Applier is a PHP CLI in local_ltuse reading JSON on stdin, driven over ssh by scripts/site_config.py
decisions.why: No core web service writes site config; local_ltuse is already on every target
decisions.rejected: A local_ltuse web-service config writer, or core admin/cli/cfg.php

decisions.decision: Declaration is YAML under moodle/site/, parsed only by Python
decisions.why: Repo data is YAML, comments needed for review, PHP needs no YAML extension

decisions.decision: Secrets resolved on the operator machine and sent only in the stdin stream; drift checks secrets as set or empty only
decisions.why: Never on disk or argv; drift runs unattended with no secrets
decisions.rejected: Server-side resolution from /etc/ltct/ops.env, or hashed comparison

decisions.decision: Settings written through admin_setting::write_setting() from the full admin tree
decisions.why: Moodle validation, update callbacks and config_log

decisions.decision: Roles declared as archetype defaults plus system-context overrides; ltcpublisher role moves out of setup_publishing.php
decisions.why: Drift can compute expected permissions; one definition per role
decisions.rejected: Full capability dumps, or keeping the role in setup_publishing.php

decisions.decision: Applier verifies plugin pins but never installs code; installing at the pinned release is provisioning (spec 015)
decisions.why: An apply run can never upgrade or downgrade (FR-003)

decisions.decision: Push (message_airnotifier) stays disabled in the baseline
decisions.why: App plan undecided (spec 015); email is the default channel
decisions.rejected: Enabling airnotifier on the free plan now

decisions.decision: A role with an archetype is managed only on the capabilities it declares; a role with archetype '' is managed exactly
decisions.why: get_default_capabilities() omits capabilities granted at install via clonepermissionsfrom, so archetype-plus-overrides would strip legitimate permissions
decisions.rejected: Comparing archetype roles against their full archetype defaults

decisions.decision: Report redacts by setting name (pass|secret|token|key|salt) as well as by password class
decisions.why: The first drift run printed airnotifieraccesskey and calendar_exportsalt, which are plain text settings

decisions.decision: debug, debugdisplay and tool_dataprivacy/dporoles are not declared
decisions.why: debug is set in config.php (provisioning owns it); dporoles only enters the admin tree after a role holds managedatarequests, and site admins are always DPO
decisions.rejected: Declaring them as env: values or adding a two-pass apply

decisions.decision: Drift skips settings whose get_setting() is true and treats an empty checkbox as 0
decisions.why: Widget settings store no value, and checkbox defaults of empty string mean unchecked; both were false unmanaged reports

decisions.decision: Push (message_airnotifier) is enabled in the baseline; supersedes "Push stays disabled"
decisions.why: ltuse.net moved to the Premium app plan on 2026-10-02: unlimited push devices at a flat rate, so constitution IX holds

decisions.decision: The declaration contract lists every extension of the declaration (Doug, 2026-10-05)

plan.summary: Plan, research, data model and three contracts for declaring, applying and drift-checking Moodle site config
plan.key_finding: No core API writes config remotely, so the applier runs server-side over ssh with JSON on stdin and every write goes through the admin settings tree

implement.summary: Site config as code built and applied to ltuse.net: YAML declaration, site_config.py, local_ltuse applier/drift; 28 of 34 tasks done, learner-device checks and fresh-server rebuild pending

approach: YAML declaration under moodle/site/ is validated and rendered by scripts/site_config.py, then streamed over ssh to local_ltuse/cli/site_config.php, which compares it with the live site through admin-settings, plugin-manager and access APIs. Apply blocks on any preflight problem before writing; drift writes nothing and exits non-zero on any difference.
